profiles.angleDefinition: Signed IUPAC dihedral of reference[0]-a-b-reference[3] in degrees; positive values follow RDKit GetDihedralDeg/SetDihedralDeg; periodic 360 degrees
profiles.environment: isolated molecule / vacuum-like force field, no explicit or implicit solvent
profiles.geometryTreatment: Only the moving fragment rotates rigidly about this bond. All bond lengths, bond angles, and other torsions remain at the exported molecule reference coordinates. No minimization at scan points.
profiles.zeroReference: Minimum sampled energy within this profile, not comparable between profiles or molecules
profiles.validity: Valid only for a single selected rotor from the exported reference conformer. Reset other torsions before displaying this profile; it is not a multidimensional potential energy surface.
